name: superflow
description: A portable full-flow dev toolkit: process skills (TDD, brainstorming, systematic-debugging, plans, code-review, verification, worktrees) woven with routed specialist personas (finder, pm, designer, dev, testers, bughunter, a11y-hunter, architect, auditor), deterministic workflows for the expensive calls (multi-voice council, adversarial review sweep), a mock-locked design loop, plus a self-scanning codebase rulebook and an opt-in per-repo specbook (persistent spec layer) so it fits any repo.
